summary: Tested new Publish Series features: 1) Status labels on series cards (Live, Under Review), 2) 'Publish Now' button on hover for unpublished series, 3) 'Publish Series' button in series detail sidebar, 4) 'Live & visible to viewers' message for published series. All features verified working.

minor.issue: CORS error from ipapi.co geo lookup service - returns 503 (known issue from previous iteration)

series_card_status_labels.notes: Series cards display status badges: 'Live' (green) for published, 'Under Review' (yellow) for pending_review

publish_now_button_on_hover.notes: 'Publish Now' button with globe icon appears on hover over unpublished series cards. Button is functional - clicking it publishes the series.

series_detail_navigation.notes: Clicking on series card navigates to /creator/series/{id}

publish_series_button_sidebar.notes: Green 'Publish Series' button appears in sidebar for unpublished series. Hidden for published series.

live_visible_message.notes: 'Live & visible to viewers' green banner shows in sidebar for published series

publish_series_api.notes: POST /creator/series/{id}/publish works - shows success toast 'Series published successfully! It's now visible to all viewers.'

features_tested.details: Status badge shows in top-right corner of series card thumbnail. Green for 'Live', yellow for 'Under Review'
Dark overlay with 'Publish Now' button appears on hover for unpublished series. Has data-testid='publish-btn-{id}'
Green button with globe icon in sidebar. Has data-testid='publish-series-btn'. Shows for unpublished series only.
Green banner with globe icon shows 'Live & visible to viewers' for published series

critical_code_review_comments: SeriesCard component properly uses data-testid for testing (series-card-{id}, publish-btn-{id})
Status labels use appropriate colors: green-500 for Live, yellow-500 for Under Review
Publish button click handler uses e.stopPropagation() to prevent card navigation when clicking publish
handlePublishSeries in CreatorPortal.jsx makes correct API call to POST /creator/series/{id}/publish
seed_data_creation: None - used existing series from previous iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Publish Series features verified working: 1) Status labels show on series cards (Live/Under Review), 2) 'Publish Now' button appears on hover for unpublished series - clicking it successfully publishes the series, 3) Series detail page shows 'Publish Series' button in sidebar for unpublished series, 4) Published series show 'Live & visible to viewers' message instead. All three test series (cs-358a8ff78a, cs-b6f412cc76, cs-25a5e436d9) are now published and showing 'Live' status.
